text.facebook: If you think your dog has drunk, licked or walked through antifreeze, ring the vet straight away and don't wait for symptoms, says the Royal Kennel Club. Kidney damage can show two to three days later. The RSPCA warns road grit and rock salt can make dogs ill if licked off paws. My tip: keep a towel and warm water by the door, and wipe paws and tummy after every winter walk. https://www.foresthounds.co.uk/blog/frost-grit-and-antifreeze
